title: Scholarship ni Tita Baby
setup: Bukas na ang deadline ng scholarship list. Nag-text si Tita Baby: 'Ako na bahala. Isang tawag lang sa kaibigan ko sa munisipyo.'
setup_en: The scholarship list closes tomorrow. Tita Baby texts: 'I'll take care of it. Just one call to my friend at the municipal hall.'

success.text_en: You make the list. Fair and square.

fail.text_en: You lose out. Money gets tighter.

choices.label: Magtanong tayo ng kriteria, kasama ang mga kaklase.
choices.label_en: Let's ask for the criteria, with our classmates.

success.text: Nagbukas ang criteria. Mas patas para sa lahat.
success.text_en: The criteria are opened. Fairer for everyone.

fail.text_en: Nothing changes, but you spoke up.

callback: Utang +2 -> Singil. spoke_up -> Organizer career + Ch4.
